projects.title: Simple Bart
projects.description:
- Display simple BART map using React & React-Router-Dom & React-Leaflet & Zustand
- Use BART API to fetch each station's coordinates, access information and real-time estimation
- Deployed on Netlify using the Manual Deployment option

projects.title: SF Food Trucks
projects.description:
A web app using React/Redux to display all food trucks in San Francisco with filters from user’s input
-Integrated Google Map and displayed food trucks’ coordinates using marker and tooltip
-Assimilated fetched data from the Reducers to components using React/Redux
-Created server using Webpack dev server and deployed on Heroku
